AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE: This Planning Commission meeting of June 16, 2020 is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Any and all Planning Commissioners may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed. The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. The Zoom Meeting ID is 816 4052 6347 (direct link: https://zoom.us/j/81640526347).
CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

minutes_text:
ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JUNE 16, 2020
Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  June 16, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Roos, Walker, Lazarro, Criley
Absent:  None
Also present: Director of Community Development & Public Works Ken Rukavina, Planning Manager
  Brianna Rindge, Planner Maddie Bright, Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  Determination of Conformance with the General Plan for Capital Improvements Program for Fiscal
  Year 2020-21

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded (5-0 in favor) to determine that the Capital Improvements
  Program for the City of Palos Verdes Estates for Fiscal Year 2020-21 conforms to the goals and
  policies of the City of Palos Verdes Estates General Plan.

2.  NC-1674-20 & G-1640-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1180); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility and Grading Applications for additions to a deck at an existing single-
  family residence located at 2241 Via Cerritos. Lot 9, Block 22, Tract 7538. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Charles Ellis

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following condition: should the Parklands Committee not designate a street tree
  for this project prior to building permit issuance, street trees will not be required.

OLD BUSINESS

3.  NC-1660-19, G-1632-19 & M-1354-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1154); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence located at 2321 Via Acalones. Lot 20, Block 1638, Tract 7330. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

Action Minutes  Page 1 of 3
July 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc., 306 Vista Del Mar A, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Steve & Amy Hogan

  Speakers: Edward Barad, Burt Walker, James McBirney, Marci Beech, Ellen Cook, Mary Kelliny,
  Robin Winston, Jennifer Choi, Sandra Winston, George Winston, Diana Gdowski, Norman Eagle,
  Janine Nendick

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-1 in favor, Roos dissenting)
  with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The civil drainage design shall comply
  with low impact development guidelines. The design shall address the increase in post development
  flow. Runoff shall be diverted to vegetated areas before discharge. The runoff from the project
  boundaries shall be conveyed to the street or an approved drainage easement. 2) The owner shall
  locate and accurately plot sewer lines for plan check/acceptance and subsequent recordation and
  shall confirm integrity before construction starts. The City shall have the right to maintain ingress
  and egress across the property to access the gated sewer cleanout for sewer maintenance and/or
  construction. The owner shall provide full gate code access to the City for sewer maintenance and/or
  construction purposes. 3) Any vegetation between the house and the northwestern property line
  shall be restricted to no higher than two feet above adjacent approved fence elevations, as depicted
  on the attached Exhibit A. On the remainder of the site, vegetation shall be restricted to no higher
  than adjacent approved retaining wall/fence elevations, as depicted on the attached Exhibit A. The
  homeowner shall not plant street trees and shall pay the in lieu fee to the Tree Bank. 4) The height
  of each ridge shall be reduced 4’ from the plan approved on June 16, 2020, such that the maximum
  ridge heights are as depicted on the attached Exhibit A, implying a drop of the floors themselves in
  the base. 5) The garage shall be shifted 6’ laterally in the southeastern direction, as depicted on the
  attached Exhibit A. 6) The chimney shall be removed, as depicted on the attached Exhibit A. 7)
  The maximum pool elevation (including pool water, spillway, and coping) shall be no higher than
  the rear patio elevation.

4.  NC-1668-19, G-1635-19, M-1386-19 & SC-140-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1173);
  Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, Miscellaneous & Sports Court
  Applications for a new single-family residence located at 2014 Via Cerritos. Lot 3, Block 5, Tract
  8043. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Luis de Moraes, Envirotechno Architecture, 116 S. Catalina Ave #102, Redondo Beach,
  CA 90277
  Owner: Varsha Patel

  Speakers: Steve Shimoyama, Robert Thornburgh, Karen Thornburgh, Eric Cheng

  Action: Continued

5.  NC-1671-20, G-1637-20 & M-1380-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1176); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence with nonstandard encroachments within the right-of-way located at 704 Via Horcada.
  Lot 1, Block 1429, Tract 8523. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeff Dahl, 1102 Main St, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
Action Minutes  Page 2 of 3
July 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Owner: Dave Farrell, 10 Hidden Valley Rd, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274

  Speakers: None

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following conditions: 1) Brickwork along edge of pavement, the rock wall, and
  the stepping stone pathway, as nonstandard encroachments, shall be removed; 2) The proposed
  walkway shall be constructed per City standard. The first 5’ of the walkway, from edge of pavement
  towards the property line, shall be constructed at a slope no greater than 2.0%; 3) A set of street
  improvement plans shall be submitted for the construction of curb and gutter or Hollywood Berm
  along the frontage of the property as directed by the City Engineer; and 4) A new Miscellaneous
  Application approval is required for any structures exceeding 3.5’ within the minimum required
  front yard setback.

NEW BUSINESS

6.  NC-1557R-20 & M-1366-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1179); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility Revision and Miscellaneous Applications for revisions to an approved
  single-family residence located at 1308 Paseo Del Mar. Lot 1, Block 1352, Tract 7536. This
  project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  Applicant: Luigi Schiappa Development Inc
  Owner: 1308 Paseo Del Mar LLC

  Speakers: None

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the conditions adopted by the approval of the original Neighborhood Compatibility
  Application No. NC-1557-16 within Resolution No. PCR-2016-0923.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

13.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

14.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

15.  Meeting of May 19, 2020.

  Action: Criley moved and Walker seconded to receive and file (5-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 10:54 P.M.

Action Minutes  Page 3 of 3
July 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
